## Where I'm at
Maya set up a 3-hour SRE take-home for a candidate and moved it into its own private repo, `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`, so the infra history stays clean. The exercise is built with Terraform and docker compose: a broken alert rule, a connection leak in `flaky-svc`, and an over-broad IAM policy. The rubric is in place with four areas scored 0–3 and no pass cut-off; Maya and Noa review independently and the panel decides. Nothing has been sent to the candidate. Maya will send the exercise herself after the Thursday 4pm call.

- [en-cours] Maya's Thursday 4pm (Tel Aviv time) call with the candidate, then Maya sends the exercise herself
- [prochaine-étape] Maya sends the exercise to the candidate after the call; invite the collaborator to `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home` when she decides
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch `docker buildx --load` failed ("docker exporter does not currently support exporting manifest lists"); fixed by building `flaky-svc` from source in compose, so it builds natively on any architecture
- [question] Whether the infra branch `maya/sre-take-home` gets dropped (its `hiring/` folder is already removed from the working tree, uncommitted)
- [décision] No pass threshold in the rubric; scores are input for the panel discussion (source: t10)
- [décision] Noa is the second reviewer, scoring independently with Maya before the panel decides together (source: t10)
- [décision] The exercise lives in its own private repo, not in infra, so candidates can't see the real modules (source: t12)
- [décision] No email goes out from the assistant; Maya sends the exercise herself after the call (source: t16)
